deviations.what: sap.m.PlanningCalendar appointmentHeight and appointmentRoundWidth are @since 1.81.0 and sap.ui.unified.CalendarAppointment description @since 1.81.0 - all newer than the 1.71 floor. The two Selects that drive them ARE the sample, so all three are kept and the port is filed under src/02.

The calendar date properties (the PlanningCalendar startDate and every CalendarAppointment startDate and endDate) are typed "object" and demand a real JS Date. The model keeps ISO strings and Formatter.DateCreateObject from the curated module converts them at the point of use, the same idiom app 108 uses (needs UI5 >= 1.74).

handleAppointmentHeightChange and handleAppointmentRoundingChange call setAppointmentHeight / setAppointmentRoundWidth. Both properties are bindable, so each Select shares its key with the calendar and neither change handler is needed.

handleSortChange hands the calendar a JavaScript comparator through setCustomAppointmentsSorterCallback (fnAlphabeticalOrder, a case-insensitive title compare). abap2UI5 cannot register a callback, so the port sorts the appointment rows THEMSELVES in ABAP with the same rule and re-seeds the original order for the default entry. Same visible order, different mechanism.
The row images are the demo kit's own test-resources files, re-hosted on sdk.openui5.org.
The four appointment sizes, the two rounding widths and the alphabetical sort are unverified in a running system.
